name: MapScreen - SummaryReattach
description: The same last-phase screen with nobody attached, which is where `dense` earns its keep. This main is an h-screen flex column, so every row the reattach strip takes is a row of the board the person came back to read. Set beside Reattach it shows the same strip paying for itself — and since the far end moved onto the board, what it is paying for is the map itself rather than a separate page.
